market_name: Best Actor: Is it Over for Timothée?
blurb: Timothée Chalamet is not having the best week... From losing the SAG award to Michael B. Jordan last weekend, to yesterday coming under fire for his dismissive comments suggesting that ‘no-one cares’ about ballet and opera that have offended many – it seems like a fall from grace for the previous set favorite. Jordan has now overtaken Chalamet's odds to win the Oscar...is it all falling apart for Chalamet, or can he make a comeback?

market_name: The shot that shook the hoops world
blurb: Powered by freshman Braylon Mullins' 35-foot game-winning 3, Connecticut came back to upset favored Duke Sunday -- drastically changing the title picture. With the Blue Devils now absent from the Final Four, the Arizona-Michigan winner is a heavy favorite to win it all, as there's just a 31% chance the champ runs through Illinois-UConn.

Rory took the green jacket on Sunday. Scottie Scheffler took the runner-up and drove straight to Hilton Head. Round 1 of the RBC Heritage is underway and traders are optimistic Scheffler can go one better this week — but it's far from safe yet. Harbour Town's tight fairways don't care about star power, and there's a long way to go.

After months of losses, the S&P 500 rallied to an all-time high on Wednesday for the first time since late January. The recovery has been as dramatic as the selloff that preceded it, and traders are now looking ahead, predicting a 62% chance that the index hits 7,300 by the end of June. The bulls are back.

A trickle of ships is now moving through Hormuz. Some vessels are changing their names to decommissioned ships ("zombie ships") to evade identification. And others are transiting under Indian naval escort after paying Iran a $2m toll. A return to normal traffic by the end of April is a 37% chance today.

Sunday brought big Game 1 consequences in the NBA playoffs: the Boston Celtics' landslide win over Philly boosted their Finals odds to an Eastern Conference-high 42%, while the Detroit Pistons' surprising loss to Orlando sent the No. 1 seed down to 14%, only fourth-highest in the conference now.

Leg 2 of the Champions League quarterfinals starts today, and by tomorrow we'll know who'll meet in the semis later this month. But let's be honest -- we kind of already know who'll probably win this. The combined odds for the top 3 teams is 80%, with Bayern Munich ahead of Arsenal and PSG.

Peru just held its messiest election in years — 50,000+ people couldn't vote, one official got arrested, and 35 candidates showed up including a comedian and a guy who calls himself a cartoon pig. Out of the chaos, Keiko Fujimori has clearly emerged on top according to Polymarket traders.

Investors are throwing money at AI companies faster than they can say no. Anthropic was said to have received offers valuing it at $800 billion — more than double its $380B valuation from February. Polymarket traders think hitting a $500B valuation by end of year looks more than set.

The NBA's regular season is over, and while the Play-In Tournament is still left to determine the "real" playoff field, it's never to early to look ahead at the championship odds. The OKC Thunder are currently 42% to defend their title, far ahead of the Spurs (15%) and Celtics (12%).

Last Friday, the Supreme Court struck down Trump's "Liberation Day" tariffs 6-3. But if you'd been watching Polymarket on November 5th, the day of the oral arguments, you wouldn't have been surprised. We pinpoint the exact moments during the hearing where the tariff case fell apart.

After staying on the sidelines for the first month of the war, Yemen's Houthis have begun firing ballistic missiles at Israel, spiking odds for Israel to retaliate. Houthi officials have said closing the vital Bab el-Mandeb waterway is “on the table” but have not hit shipping yet.

Trump says the Strait of Hormuz is “completely open,” but the U.S. naval blockade stays until the Iran deal is “100% complete." Markets were already pricing a return to normal traffic by late April, and the post adds more momentum. Now it’s just a question of timing on the deal.

market_name: Who will Justin Bieber feature at Coachella?
blurb: Justin Bieber looks ready to go for his headlining Coachella act this weekend. Fans speculate whether he'll bring out an old favorite to open his set, after Bieber confirmed he’ll perform songs from both ‘Swag’ projects, along with some of his classic hits. What will be first?

Meanwhile, previous favorite Teyana Taylor has lost her top spot to Amy Madigan after the SAGs, whilst newcomer from the Sinners family Wunmi Mosaku's odds are creeping up, threatening them both. Sinners is having a moment, and may cause a surprise even for this category...

Sinners has a record breaking 16 nominations for the Oscar’s. After a stunning sweep at the SAGs, and cast members threatening seemingly decided Oscar’s categories, it looks like we are set for a few surprises. However, fans are divided on just how many it can take home.

Jannik Sinner reclaimed his No. 1 world ranking by beating Carlos Alcaraz this past weekend to win the Monte-Carlo Masters. But Alcaraz still tops in the market: The Spaniard is favored to win 2 of the 3 remaining Grand Slams, and is co-favored with Sinner at Wimbledon.

On Tuesday, Trump announced an indefinite extension of the ceasefire, but Iran has shot at three and seized two ships in the Gulf since then. Tehran says the attacks were a response to Trump'sblockade and ceasefire violations. Oil is back over $100 this morning.

MLB returns from hibernation with tonight's Yankees-Giants opener. But the big concern hanging over the season is a labor battle when the agreement between owners and players expires on Dec. 1. Traders currently price the chance of a renewal by then at just 48%.

Technically speaking, it's not quite NBA playoff time yet... But the Play-In Tournament to decide who sneaks into the playoffs is upon us, and tonight the Clippers (67%) and Sixers (54%) are favored to beat the Warriors and Magic on night No. 2 of the Play-In.

market_name: Will a Claude Mythos model be released by April 30, 2026?
blurb: The 2026 NCAA championship is tonight. Michigan is a 74% favorite to beat UConn, but something's gotta give: Michigan will either have one of the largest tourney PPG margins of any champ ever (currently +21.6) or UConn will win its third title in four years.

market_name: Will China GDP growth in Q1 2026 be between 5.0% and 5.5%?
blurb: With 1 day left in the NHL regular season, we still have no idea who the 2025-26 MVP will be. Three different players -- Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon and Nikita Kucherov -- have between 30% and 40% odds, making the award race a very unusual toss-up.

Oil is up and stocks are down after Trump's speech last night didn't signal a wind down of the war. Instead, there are new reports that the president is considering a plan to seize Iran's nuclear materials in a daring commando raid. Can he pull it off?

Iran has formed an interim council made up of President Masoud Pezeshkian, Chief Justice Mohseni‑Ejei, and Alireza Arafi, a senior cleric. Arafi's religious status makes him most likely to be named as the next Supreme Leader, should the regime survive.

There are conflicting reports as to whether the strategic oil passageway is open or shut. Vessel trackers are showing some ships transiting through with their location tracking turned off. A full closure becomes more likely if the conflict drags on.

"Scorigamis" (first-time score combos) aren’t just a football thing, you can trade them in baseball, too. Just know what you’re buying: MLB has been around forever, and new scores are extremely rare. The last one hit in 2020, and before that, 1999.

While the other most likely Final Four teams are still 1-seeds, wins Thursday by No. 3 Illinois and No. 9 Iowa guarantee at least one semi-deep pick reaches the national semifinals. Illinois currently has a 73% chance to beat the Hawkeyes Saturday.

Sorry, Duke-haters: the Blue Devils are favorites again to win the NCAA tournament. (Followed by Michigan, Arizona and defending champ Florida.) Duke hasn't won the title since 2015, but this is one of the best teams they've had in program history.

market_name: Cristopher Sanchez was favorite to win Cy Young over reigning winner Paul Skenes when the latter had his
blurb: Cristopher Sanchez was favorite to win Cy Young over reigning winner Paul Skenes when the latter had his worst-ever start on Opening Day. But Skenes was closer to his usual self on Wednesday, so traders restored him to No. 1 in the odds...for now.

The NBA MVP race was drifting towards Victor Wembanyama (and away from favorite Shai Gilgeous-Alexander), to the point SGA had to address it. “I let my game do the talking,” he said Monday. Probably smart: SGA still has an 80%+ chance to win.

British computer scientist Adam Back has rejected claims from the New York Times that he is Bitcoin creator Satoshi Nakamoto. However, Polymarket traders believe the "Finding Satoshi" documentary will identify him as such. Will we ever know?

Week 2 of the NCAA tournament starts this evening, which means eight more games along the path to the national title. The closest in the odds, with a pair of 54% favorites: Nebraska vs. Iowa tonight, and UConn vs. Michigan State tomorrow.

market_name: What Iranian demands will Trump agree to by May 31?
blurb: Trump is urging a quick end to the DHS shutdown, but Speaker Mike Johnson seems unwilling or unable to deliver the votes. Over 1,110 TSA officers have reportedly quit since the DHS shutdown began on February 14. How long will this last?

With no {official} nominees yet and the midterm elections set to reshape the political landscape this year, traders are catching wind on which party is seizing momentum. Democratic Presidential odds hit all time highs heading into 2028.

Brazil's October presidential race is one of the hottest global polymarkets. A new set of polls has put right wing candidate Flavio Bolsonaro (son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro) into a narrow lead over the incumbent Lula.

We don't fully know the NBA Play-In Tournament entries from the East yet, but we do know the West -- the Suns (82%) and Clippers (57%) are clear favorites to grab the last 2 playoff spots over the Blazers (37%) and Warriors (24%).

Sony and Marvel just unveiled new teaser posters for the highly anticipated upcoming 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' movie featuring Tom Holland. It looks set to be the highest grossing movie of 2026, according to Polymarket traders.

Last Saturday, Joe Rogan visited the White House for an executive order easing restrictions on psychedelics. Now, several outlets are reporting that a Trump order to move weed to Schedule III could come this week. Are you ready?

market_name: Will OpenAI have the best Math AI model at the end of April 2026?
blurb: OpenAI released GPT 5.5, codenamed 'Spud', yesterday. According to OpenAI, the model outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 4.5 across a number of benchmarks - but can it unseat Anthropic as top model in blind user testing?

The U.S., Iran, and Israel agreed to a two-week ceasefire last night. But there are reports of attacks ongoing this morning, including an Emirati attack on Iran's Lavan oil refinery. Will the ceasefire last the full 14 days?

It's been a chaotic 72 hours in Hormuz. IRGC boats are attacking ships attempting to run U.S. and Iranian blockades. Polymarket traders still think a peace deal is in the cards, but it's looking more like early Summer now.

Chaos reigns at the women's Madrid Open, where only 1 of the top 12 seeds in the tournament is still active. After favorite Aryna Sabalenka was upset on Tuesday, no remaining player has even a 30% chance to win the title.

US and Iran fail to reach deal after 21-hour marathon talks in Pakistan. According to U.S. VP JD Vance, negotiations broke down after Iran declined to guarantee it won’t pursue nuclear weapons. When will the conflict end?

Iran and the U.S. are negotiating in public over a possible ceasefire, with Iran requesting to deal directly with Vance, a known skeptic of Middle East wars. Odds for a ceasefire in the April-May timeframe are increasing.

Trump's Chief-of-Staff Susie Wiles, who oversees the Secret Service, is getting blamed for lax security at the White House Correspondent's Dinner. Her odds of getting fired this year are spiking on the Daily Beast story.

Coming out of its opening weekend, traders still think the 2026 NCAA tournament belongs to the big favorites, with Arizona, Michigan and Duke at 61% combined to win, a figure that becomes 73% if you also include Houston.

This morning, for a brief moment, Georgia Senator Jon Ossoff flipped AOC for second place in the 2028 Democratic nomination odds. Somewhere in northern Virginia a DNC staffer is cooking some dank "Ossoff-mentum" memes.

After taking the biggest lead in tournament history into the weekend, McIlroy suffered a huge setback yesterday. Traders remain hopeful he can pull off a victory against Young, but his odds are now less than certain.

Iran is allowing a trickle of ships through the Strait of Hormuz, either to collect toll payments or as a bargaining chip with Trump. But Polymarket traders project that traffic will remain constrained through April.

Apparently the NL East is all about ridiculously long losing streaks. First, the Mets lost 12 in a row; now the Phillies are sitting on 9 straight losses with a 56% chance of hitting double-digits this evening.

FBI Director Kash Patel has shot to the top of the 'most likely to get fired' power rankings following an Atlantic article alleging problematic drinking habits. Patel is suing the publication for $250 million.

market_name: expected to file its prospectus in the next two weeks. Polymarket traders put a 49% chance of SpaceX's IPO valuation exceeding $2 trillion.
blurb: The Information reports SpaceX has moved forward its IPO plans and is expected to file its prospectus in the next two weeks. Polymarket traders put a 49% chance of SpaceX's IPO valuation exceeding $2 trillion.

Doomberg, a pseudonymous team of former commodity execs writes one of the most popular Substacks on energy and geopolitics. We talk energy implications of Iran's missile war and where the next domino may drop.

Despite Anthropic being labeled a "supply chain risk" by the U.S. government, Axios reports that the NSA is going hog wild with the lab's new super hacking model "Mythos." Will the USG come back to the table?

Justin Bieber's Coachella set broke records last weekend and sent the internet into meltdown. With his second weekend performance coming up, Polymarket traders are looking ahead to who he brings out on stage.

Pro-Trump Flávio Bolsonaro officially overtakes China-aligned Lula da Silva as the frontrunner to win the Brazil presidential election. However, the odds are incredibly close, and it looks like anyone's game.

Seeds don't always tell the story. Statistical power ratings say Iowa, Utah State, Saint Louis and Texas A&M are among the lower-seeded teams that have the highest odds to win their games in the Round of 64.

market_name: Is this who the orange cat was referring to? One of Polymarket's top geopolitical traders is heavily on YES for an April ceasefire.
blurb: Axios is reporting that the U.S. is "in deep negotiations" with Iran on a potential 45-day ceasefire ahead of Trump's deadline of 8pm EST on Tuesday night. April ceasefire odds moved 18% -> 28% on the news.

market_name: Falling out of love with Gavin?
blurb: The Iran war has boosted the Democrats' 2028 presidential odds. Newsom remains the most likely nominee, but his odds have dropped from a high of 40% in November to just 24% Today. AOC is slipping as well...

The Trumps are demanding ABC fire Jimmy Kimmel for his "expectant widow" joke about Melania. In 2024 ABC agreed to pay Trump's presidential library $15m to settle defamation charges. Will Trump sue again?
